text: Yes, tree-cover loss on this property has been increasing in recent years. The data shows a significant loss event in 2021 (81.3 ha), followed by smaller but notable losses in 2022 (0.6 ha) and 2023 (4.5 ha). While the 2022 loss was minimal, the 2023 loss more than doubled compared to 2022. Historically, annual losses were typically around 1-2 ha, but the 2021 spike marks a sharp increase, with continued—though smaller—losses in subsequent years. The trend suggests rising deforestation activity, particularly in 2021.
